org.micromanager.display.overlay

Interface OverlaySupport


  • public interface OverlaySupport
    Interface for data viewers that support MM Inspector overlays without implementing the full DisplayWindow.

    Implement this interface to allow the Overlays Inspector panel to attach to a custom viewer (e.g. TiledDataViewerDataViewer).
